strategies: Use extremely bold (font-black, 800/900 weight) for headings to create visual tension.
Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive headings, and wide tracking for overlines.
Body text must remain neutral and readable (font-normal) to maintain trust and financial credibility.
Do NOT center text by default; use left alignment for strong structural grids.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] leading-[0.95] tracking-tighter font-black
scale.labels: text-xs md:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-neutral-500

visual_enhancers.background: Use a subtle grain/noise overlay globally. Mix slow-moving soft pastel CSS radial gradients (green/beige/lavender) in the hero to create the 'light/airy' mesh background.
visual_enhancers.cards: Product cards must be dark forest green (#0F291E) to contrast the light airy background. Use a 1px solid inner border (border-white/10) to define edges.
visual_enhancers.spotlight: Add a radial gradient spotlight effect on hover for the dark product cards.
visual_enhancers.lines: Connect the product cards using a drawn SVG path with Framer Motion to illustrate the Store -> Deposit -> Accept -> Spend flow.

hero.layout: Grid or flex layout balancing massive typography on the left/top and a connected cluster of 4 dark green product cards on the right/bottom.
hero.motion: Implement Awwwards-style scroll-triggered line-by-line staggered text reveal for the H1 using overflow-hidden wrappers and translateY.
hero.stats_row: Minimal inline stats row (04 products, 6+ networks, 99.99% uptime, Real-time) with bold numbers and small labels.

manifesto.style: Minimalist text over light background. Huge chapter numbers (01, 02, 03) in a light gray (#E5E5E5) acting as watermarks or anchors for paragraphs.

products.layout: Bento grid or vertical staggered scroll layout for Bexo, OpenDeposit, ActaPay, Straight.
products.style: Dark forest green product UI cards placed within a light container. Use clipping masks and spotlight effects. Showcase product capabilities via UI abstractions inside the cards.

marquee.style: Slow editorial ribbon. Pale background, wide tracking, uppercase sans-serif.
marquee.content: A continuous loop emphasizing 'The Payment Interface Layer for Programmable Money — Interoperable Ecosystem'

footer.layout: Massive bottom footer with 'Let's Talk' CTA at text-[10vw] filling the width.
footer.style: Dark background (#0A0A0A) for the footer to provide a final heavy grounding, or keep it ultra-light with black text.

guidelines: Use Lenis for premium smooth momentum scrolling.
Hero text must use Framer Motion for line-by-line reveal (translateY from 100% to 0 inside an overflow-hidden wrapper, staggered by 0.1s).
Product connection lines must draw themselves (SVG pathLength from 0 to 1) on load.
Implement subtle parallax on background mesh and floating elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the CTA button (#4F46E5) and deep black text (#0A0A0A) meet WCAG 3:1 against the light background. Green text inside dark cards must use a bright neon variant for contrast.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the line animations and marquee.

images.description: Soft gradient background reference for mesh

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use grid, overlap, and asymmetry. Tension creates interest.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and optical alignment.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions (opacity, transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations. Limit primary color to CTAs.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12, p-24) to avoid cramped designs. Negative space is a premium feature.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: 3. Implement the light background with soft pastel mesh gradients in CSS (green, beige, lavender) with a noise overlay.

4. HERO: Build a dynamic layout. Left side: Massive H1 'Programmable Money' using line-by-line reveal. Right side: A kinetic graphic with 4 dark green cards (Store, Deposit, Accept, Spend) linked by SVG paths drawing themselves.
5. MANIFESTO: Swiss grid with large numbering ('01', '02'). Left-align content. Emphasize the bold typography and use negative space.
6. PRODUCTS: 4 bento boxes or vertical list of the dark green product UI cards. Keep the contrast stark against the light site background.
7. FOOTER & MARQUEE: Simple, bold footer with an oversized CTA and an editorial slow-scrolling marquee directly above it.
